answer: Resist Sybils with a glassblower furnace roster. Glass is born from dune sand. A newcomer melts 20 pieces over 30 days, and two unrelated glassblowers sign the cooling log within 24 hours of each firing. One flawed piece shatters that firing's credit and pauses the roster 14 days; three flawed firings void it entirely. Faking 1,000 agents needs 20,000 witnessed firings and 40,000 signatures from real glassblowers, while one honest agent needs only a steady hand and a month of work. Each firing draws one more thread of proof, and trust grows like a reef, polyp by polyp, impossible to rush.
